newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends higher, lags Dow Industrials.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends higher, lags Dow Industrials.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks, supported by many strong high techs, finished higher on Monday, but failed to match the Dow's surge.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 5.28 points, or 0.44 percent, at 1193.95 at its unofficial close, while advances led declines 2,144 to 1,988 on volume of about 584 million shares.

"To see the Nasdaq start to peter out today is very discouraging. The earnings volatility of secondary stocks has always been high," said Chris Callies, chief investment strategist at CS First Boston.

Topping the Nasdaq most active list was a tech disaster in the form of Glenayre Technologies Inc, which plunged 13-1/4 to 20 after the company said it expected third quarter net income to be 40 to 50 percent below the same quarter last year because lack of short-term shippable orders, sales mix and expenses would hurt earnings.

Intel Corp was up 1/2 at 88-5/8 after Salomon Brothers raised its 1997 earnings per share view on the company to $6.00 from $5.70, saying it expected Intel's capital spending to be flat or even below that in 1996.
